description: Client-side script for 'Exchange Rate Revaluation' form in ERPNext, handling setup, data retrieval, calculations, and interactions for exchange rate revaluation process.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets query filters for 'party_type' and 'account' fields in the form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Checks journal entry condition and adds custom button for journal entry creation if applicable.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches account data and updates the form's accounts table.

methods.name: get_total_gain_loss
methods.description: Calculates total gain or loss based on account balances and updates the form.

methods.name: make_jv
methods.description: Creates a journal voucher entry and navigates to its form.
